items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It started at my house with Oprah, him, and Michelle, the whole thing, a year and a half ago... They’re like family.

ctx.x: . . . to do that, because – it’s too bad that you don’t have a copyright on all of the shit you have invented, because you’d be a trillionaire.
We’ve got Oprah and Will Smith. Will Smith’s the biggest thing in Hollywood history. It’s unbelievable. Hancock [sic: Smith ?] is at $300-million.
